text: Irakli Kupradze - The anti-Georgian "Dream" bringing the Minister of Defense to the empty shore of Anaklia, where nothing is happening, the photo session and ministers walking in circles, is ridiculous propaganda that we will not believe! (07.05.2026, 13:56)

"The taking of the Minister of Defense by the anti-Georgian 'Dream' yesterday to the empty shore of Anaklia, where no work is being carried out, the photo session, and the 'Georgian Dream' minister walking in circles, is ridiculous propaganda that we, the citizens of Georgia, will not believe," stated Irakli Kupradze, the General Secretary of "Lelo-Strong Georgia," at a briefing.
According to him, the Anaklia port was supposed to receive its first ship in 2020, but today we see a non-existent project, collapsed negotiations, and Western investors driven out of the country.

"The anti-Georgian 'Dream' has lost itself in its own lies. They are drowning in the propaganda and lies they produce. Yesterday, stories were spread through the anti-Georgian 'Dream's' propaganda outlets, according to which the construction of the Anaklia Port has supposedly begun. This is yet another bluff and trick on the part of Bidzina Ivanishvili, which indicates that the statements made by 'Georgian Dream' over the past 6 years were lies. For the umpteenth time—perhaps one of several dozen instances—they have announced that the construction of the Anaklia Port started today. In reality, everything is a lie, propaganda, and a bluff on the part of Bidzina Ivanishvili."

In 2024, amidst another such trick, Bidzina Ivanishvili and his propaganda machine came out and said that in just a few days, an agreement would be signed with a Chinese consortium, which would also begin construction. Today, it is confirmed once again that every promise made so far, every date, was a lie. Only dry propaganda from Ivanishvili and the anti-Georgian "Dream."

In 2026, today, there is neither an investor nor a completed and built Anaklia Port; the master plan and the general plan, which should have been agreed upon multiple times, no longer exist. Both this general plan and the master plan were thrown into the trash. A new so-called master plan was ordered by the Ministry of Economy, according to which Ivanishvili and his anti-Georgian "Dream" are calling the overall purpose and effectiveness into question.

Yesterday, the anti-Georgian "Dream" taking the Minister of Defense to the empty shore of Anaklia, where no work is underway, the photo session, and the "Georgian Dream" minister walking in circles is ridiculous propaganda that we, the citizens of Georgia, will not believe. The fact is this: while the Anaklia port should have received its first ship in 2020, today we see a non-existent project, failed negotiations, and Western investors—American and European investors—expelled from the country. Under these conditions, it is impossible for Ivanishvili to build the Anaklia port. He does not want to build the Anaklia port; he has an interest in Georgia losing this crucial strategic facility.

A window of new opportunities is clearly open, which is expressed by the once again loudly voiced interest of our partners that the Black Sea is an interest of our partners. Ivanishvili is making the country lose this opportunity, trying to get by through propaganda.

"Lelo Strong Georgia" is a political party that is the main supporter of this national and strategic facility. The project, which is called "Anaklia." We have a specific plan for how the Anaklia project should be built. After coming to power, as the very first step, Anaklia Port must be declared a project of national and strategic importance; all contracts must be public, not behind a "black curtain" as Ivanishvili does, whether it be "Arab cities" or otherwise. The presence of Chinese and Russian investments, which could potentially contradict Georgia's national interests, must be declared unacceptable. Anaklia Port must be built with state involvement, based on the principle of cooperation with Western and American partners.
"No matter how many ministers stroll on the Anaklia coast, where no work is being carried out, we will definitely build the port," Kupradze notes.

As a reminder, yesterday, the Minister of Economy and Sustainable Development Mariam Kvrivishvili, together with Vice Prime Minister and Minister of Defense Irakli Chikovani, inspected the ongoing works at the Anaklia Port territory. As the Minister of Economy noted, “the process has already entered a fairly active phase.”
